summary: Iteration 4 backend testing complete. All 31 pytest tests pass (100%), including 8 new tests for in-app notifications: (a) personil POST /api/requests inserts one notification per admin with type=new_request, ref_id=request.id, ref_route=/requests, read=false, and message containing personil name + both dates; (b) GET /api/notifications is filtered by current user_id (personil does not see admin notifications); (c) PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read persists read=true; (d) PATCH by wrong owner returns 404; (e) unauth PATCH returns 401/403; (f) POST /api/notifications/read-all returns {ok:true, updated:N>=1} and unread drops to 0; (g) admin-self-created request still creates admin notification; (h) both notification endpoints require auth. All previous 23 regression tests still pass (auth, personil CRUD, schedule generate/cell/audit/summary, requests decide with conflict/force including Penugasan bypass and reject path, settings CRUD/min_active_per_shift, stats).
critical_code_review_comments: Notifications endpoint uses to_list(limit) but sort is applied before to_list — correct. However, GET /api/notifications has no pagination cursor; if a user accumulates thousands of notifications the default limit=30 is fine but there is no way to page beyond 30 except by increasing limit. Consider adding since_ts / offset if history view is added.
create_request loads all admins via find(...).to_list(100) — hard cap 100 admins. Realistic today but note if org grows.
PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read returns {ok:true} even when the notification was already read (matched_count>0, modified_count may be 0). Fine for idempotency but not distinguishable in response.
The message text embeds request type and dates via Indonesian string with →; ensure email/UTF handling on frontend renders correctly (verified in-DB stored properly).
Notifications collection is unindexed on (user_id, created_at, read). For scale, add compound index {user_id:1, read:1, created_at:-1}.
server.py now ~793 lines — still over 700-line split threshold. Suggest routers/notifications.py.

First test run had 2 pre-existing test-data pollution failures in TestConflictAndForce (6 personil on Pagi 2026-03-10 leftover from prior iterations). Cleaned TEST_conf_* users/schedules/requests; consider adding a conftest.py session-scoped teardown to purge TEST_* prefixed data.
